sisi.depan: A central diagnostic console made of white polymer and polished teak projects a soft green holographic display between two tall, narrow windows looking out onto a garden with tiered pavilions.
sisi.kanan: A floor-to-ceiling recessed supply cabinet with frosted smart-glass doors, etched with a faint Galians crest, is built into the wall next to a bio-gel dispenser unit.
sisi.kiri: A wide, seamless sliding door, decorated with a laser-cut kawung batik motif, is set beside a wall-mounted vital signs monitor with a glowing green interface.
sisi.belakang: The smooth, curved rear wall is a continuous white surface featuring integrated, vertical light strips that glow with a gentle warmth.

tengah: Two rounded, white medical pods with gold-trimmed bases face towards the front, and a third pod faces towards the right wall.
atas: The ceiling is a multi-tiered, recessed structure inspired by a joglo roof, with soft, indirect light emanating from the gaps between each white level.
